people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
translations.bsb: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
translations.kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
translations.asv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore. Psalm 19 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
